content.comment_body: Hello! I'm looking for a way to add an ON indicator in [product_name]. Does anyone have an example? This is for a lighting control setup, where all outputs for ON and OFF are momentary. I'm searching for a solution where the indicator lights up when the ON output is active and turns off when the OFF output is triggered. The relays for lighting ON and OFF are impulse controlled, so the indicator should turn on with the ON output and stay lit until the OFF output is engaged. Any suggestions? Regards// [user_name]
Try using a switch button and make sure the writable option isn't checked.

I've already tried that. The issue is: the ON for the lights (Q1) is a momentary activation, and the OFF (Q2) is a momentary deactivation. Is there a way for the switch indicator to stay on until the Q2 relay disengages? I need the indicator to turn on when Q1 is activated, and even after Q1 is released and the lights remain on (thanks to holding relays), the indicator needs to stay lit until Q2 is deactivated.
Check out the video I've attached.
That solution looks ideal, thank you very much.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is seeking a method for displaying an ON indicator in [product_name] that accurately shows the state of lighting relays operated by momentary output signals. They are specifically interested in approaches that allow the indicator to stay illuminated after the ON relay is triggered and only turn off when the OFF relay is engaged, given the impulse-controlled hardware setup. This highlights a key user interface challenge in presenting persistent states for momentary-controlled outputs.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the indicator in [product_name] to remain ON following activation of the ON relay and only switch OFF when the OFF relay is activated, irrespective of whether the outputs themselves are momentary.
